ex.s: However, according to a report by the World Wildlife Fund, tourists ____18____ (leave) over 1.3 billion tons of food waste last year, ____19____ accounted for about 8% of the total global gas release in 2024.
ex.t: 然而，根据世界自然基金会的一份报告，游客去年___18___（留下）超过13亿吨食物垃圾，___19___约占2024年全球气体排放总量的8%。

ex.s: Using a global dataset of 1.9 billion records of plants, insects, birds, and animals, Daru and his team tested how well these data represent actual global biodiversity patterns.
ex.t: 利用包含19亿条植物、昆虫、鸟类和动物记录的全球数据集，Daru及其团队检验了这些数据在多大程度上代表了实际的全球生物多样性模式。

ex.s: It is calculated that European railways alone spend approximately 20 billion euros a year on maintenance, including sending maintenance staff, often at night, to inspect and repair the rail infrastructure.
ex.t: 据估算，仅欧洲铁路每年在维护上就花费约200亿欧元，包括派遣维护人员（常在夜间）检查和修理铁路基础设施。

ex.s: From 2000 to 2019, there were 7,348 major natural disasters around the world,____19____(result) in USD 2,970 billion in economic loss．Much of this increase can be due to climate change.
ex.t: 从2000年到2019年全球共发生7,348次重大自然灾害造成29,700亿美元的经济损失．这种增长很大程度上可能是由于气候变化造成的．

ex.t: 该州去年生产了28亿磅奶酪！

ex.s: Soon, it was understood that the Sun was just one star among billions in the galaxy we call the Milky Way.
ex.t: 很快，人们明白了太阳只是我们称之为银河系的星系中数十亿颗恒星中的一颗。

ex.s: Since 1934, better than half a billion dollars has gone into that Fund to purchase more than 5 million acres of habitat.
ex.t: 自1934年以来，超过5亿美元进入该基金，用于购买500多万英亩的栖息地。

ex.s: In the race to document the species on Earth before they go extinct, researchers and citizen scientists have collected billions of records.
ex.t: 在赶在物种灭绝前记录地球物种的竞赛中，研究人员和公民科学家已收集了数十亿条记录。

ex.s: We are the products of evolution, and not just evolution that occurred billions of years ago.
ex.t: 我们是进化的产物，而且不仅仅是数十亿年前发生的进化。

ex.s: Americans use more than 100 billion thin film plastic bags every year.
ex.t: 美国人每年使用超过1000亿个薄塑料袋。

ex.s: Recent studies estimate that between 400 million and 1 billion birds die from window impacts each year in the US alone.
ex.t: 最近的研究估计，仅在美国，每年就有4亿到10亿只鸟因撞击窗户而死亡。
